title: Evaluation Case
description: One real-content case used for pre-production visual curation. `derivedProfile` is evidence/labeling produced by channel-content-os's real deterministic classifiers (content-classification/density-engine.ts, narrative-engine.ts, format-classifier.ts) -- it is NEVER a manually authored ContentStyle/ContentVariant/ContentProfile taxonomy. `notes` may describe the case in human terms (e.g. 'message-led / sparse / image-supported') but is descriptive only and must never be read as an authoritative classification axis -- `derivedProfile` is the only authoritative classification here.

content.description: The real content payload this case evaluates. Every field must be demonstrably real (existing brand copy, or explicitly marked evaluation-only) -- never invented facts/claims/statistics.

isAuthoritative.description: true only if this content demonstrably exists in real Kaduse source material (e.g. a prior real production manifest). false means it was authored solely to make this visual evaluation possible and must never be labeled real brand copy.

provenance.description: Where this content came from, e.g. a real repo-relative manifest path, or 'evaluation-copy: not present in any real Kaduse source'.

derivedProfile.description: Evidence only -- computed, not hand-maintained. Recompute via channel-content-os's deriveDesignRetrievalContext() if the content above ever changes.

computedBy.description: Which real function produced this, e.g. 'channel-content-os:deriveDesignRetrievalContext'.

notes.description: Optional human-readable, non-authoritative description of the case.
